expectations.text: States that a written agreement or reminder is not enforcement
expectations.evidence: "CONTRIBUTING.md, a Slack pin, and two standup mentions are three instances of the same device — training. In Shingo's ladder they're rung 0: they rely on someone remembering at the moment of the commit."

expectations.text: Recommends a pre-commit hook to run the formatter automatically
expectations.evidence: "Pre-commit hook runs the formatter in write mode on staged files — it fixes and restages rather than failing."

expectations.text: Notes that pre-commit is bypassable with --no-verify and must be backed by a CI check
expectations.evidence: "Never rely on the hook alone — --no-verify exists and people under deadline use it." and "CI runs the same formatter in check mode as a required check. This is the actual enforcement."

expectations.text: Recommends a type check as a required CI check
expectations.evidence: "Fail only on new untyped code. The violation count can only go down. Required check + branch protection."

expectations.text: Recommends baselining or ratcheting rather than enforcing across the whole repo at once
expectations.evidence: "Generate a baseline of existing violations, or enforce on changed files only. Turning mypy --strict on across an existing repo yields hundreds of failures."

expectations.text: Notes that branch protection is what makes a CI check actually required
expectations.evidence: "Required check + branch protection. Without branch protection, a CI workflow is advisory and the whole device is inert."

expectations.text: Recommends the failure message tell the developer how to fix it
expectations.evidence: "Make the failure message teach. error: rule violated produces a workaround... produces a fix. This is the one place prose belongs."

expectations.text: Does not primarily recommend rewriting CONTRIBUTING.md, more reminders, or more discipline
expectations.evidence: Primary recommendations are devices (hooks, CI, ratcheting). CONTRIBUTING.md mention is secondary: "Delete the CONTRIBUTING.md paragraph — replace it with one line pointing at the gate."
